2. The ADC Manufacturing Bottlenecks thread has been fully addressed by our procurement team — please mark it as closed/finished.

3. We're launching a new research thread on a topic of your choosing related to biotech (something not already covered in our existing threads). Populate it with at least one note, one source URL with a description, and one key finding.

4. Record at least one key finding on the Donanemab Alzheimers Launch thread.

5. Generate today's nightly research briefing document (named exactly `YYYY-MM-DD.md` using today's date) in the reports folder. It must follow our standard briefing format with a header, at least two titled research sections, and inline source links throughout.

Please use the existing tooling in the scripts/ directory to do all of this.
